CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm34_appr_id WHERE tdm34_role_allc_id = tdm30_role_allc_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('99','40') ) != 0 THEN true ELSE false END
mapper.select: SELECT , AS appr_yn FROM tdm30_role_allc LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id WHERE tdm30_role_allc_id = #{roleAllcId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm30_role_allc ( tdm30_role_allc_id, tdm30_company_id, tdm30_role_id, tdm30_person_id, tdm30_add_title_yn , tdm30_start_date, tdm30_end_date, tdm30_upd_nm, tdm30_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{roleAllcId}, #{companyId}, #{roleId}, #{personId}, #{addTitleYn} , #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm34_role_allc_detail_id AS role_allc_detail_id , tdm34_role_allc_id AS role_allc_id , tdm34_role_allc_date AS role_allc_date , tdm34_reg_reason AS reg_reason , tdm34_deputy_emp_nm AS deputy_emp_name , tdm34_appr_id AS appr_id , COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '00') AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm30_add_title_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS add_title_yn_str , tdm34_upd_nm AS upd_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm34_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm34_appr_id WHERE tdm34_role_allc_id = #{roleAllcId} ORDER BY tdm34_role_allc_date DESC

SELECT tdm30_company_id AS company_id , tdm30_person_id AS person_id , tdm34_role_allc_date AS role_allc_date FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id WHERE tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm34_role_allc_detail ( tdm34_role_allc_detail_id, tdm34_role_allc_id, tdm34_role_allc_date, tdm34_reg_reason, tdm34_deputy_emp_nm , tdm34_upd_nm, tdm34_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{roleAllcDetailId}, #{roleAllcId}, #{roleAllcDate}, #{regReason}, #{deputyEmpName} , #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm35_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS role_allc_task_id , tdm35_task_id AS task_id , tdm35_task_nm AS task_name , tdm35_appr_yn AS appr_yn FROM ( /*---- 임원동의서 상신중 또는 완료인 경우 상신시점의 책무세부 select ----*/ SELECT DISTINCT tdm35_task_id , tdm35_task_nm , true AS tdm35_appr_yn FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm35_role_allc_task ON tdm35_role_allc_detail_id = tdm34_role_allc_detail_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm34_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('99','40') /*(40:반려/99:임시저장)*/
/*---- 임원동의서 상신전인 경우 기본정보의 책무세부 select ----*/ UNION ALL SELECT tdm10_task_id AS tdm35_task_id , tdm10_task_nm AS tdm35_task_nm , false AS tdm35_appr_yn FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_role_id = tdm30_role_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON ( tdm10_task_id = tdm21_task_id AND tdm34_role_allc_date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) WHERE 1=1 AND tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm34_appr_id WHERE tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('99','40') ) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) t

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm35_task_relate_detail_seq) AS role_allc_task_id , tdm35_task_relate_detail_nm AS task_relate_detail_name FROM ( SELECT tdm12_task_relate_detail_id AS tdm35_task_relate_detail_id , tdm12_content AS tdm35_task_relate_detail_nm , tdm12_seq AS tdm35_task_relate_detail_seq FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_role_id = tdm30_role_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON ( tdm10_task_id = tdm21_task_id AND tdm34_role_allc_date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) INNER JOIN tdm12_task_relate_detail ON ( tdm12_task_id = tdm10_task_id AND COALESCE(tdm12_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) WHERE 1=1 AND tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND tdm10_task_id = #{taskId} ) t

SELECT tdm30_role_allc_detail_id AS role_allc_detail_id , COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') AS appr_status_code FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}, false) tdm30 LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm30_appr_id WHERE tdm30_person_id = #{exctId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm35_role_allc_task SELECT f_create_seq() , tdm34_role_allc_detail_id , tdm10_task_id , tdm10_task_nm , tdm12_task_relate_detail_id , tdm12_content , tdm12_seq , tdm13_task_relate_duty_id , tdm13_content , tdm13_seq , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_role_id = tdm30_role_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON ( tdm10_task_id = tdm21_task_id AND tdm34_role_allc_date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) INNER JOIN tdm12_task_relate_detail ON ( tdm12_task_id = tdm10_task_id AND COALESCE(tdm12_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) INNER JOIN tdm13_task_relate_duty ON ( tdm13_task_id = tdm12_task_id AND tdm13_task_relate_detail_id = tdm12_task_relate_detail_id AND COALESCE(tdm13_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) WHERE tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} ORDER BY tdm10_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", tdm12_seq, tdm13_seq
mapper.select: SELECT tdm31_role_desc_id FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{roleAllcDate}, true) tdm30 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(tdm34_role_allc_date) next_role_allc_date FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = tdm34_appr_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' ) WHERE tdm34_role_allc_id = tdm30_role_allc_id AND tdm34_role_allc_date > tdm30_role_allc_date ) t ON true INNER JOIN tdm31_role_desc ON tdm31_role_allc_id = tdm30_role_allc_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = tdm31_appr_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' ) WHERE tdm30_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND tdm31_allc_std_date >= tdm30_role_allc_date AND tdm31_allc_std_date < COALESCE(next_role_allc_date, '2999-12-31'::date) ORDER BY tdm31_allc_std_date DESC, tdm31_reg_date DESC, tdm31_role_desc_id DESC LIMIT 1
